design_deviations: Section 7 cleanup: an attached (non-detached) cancel keeps the existing invariant (stop only an identity bound by the attempt's own observation); only a holderless owner after runtime end binds the exact process from one authenticated snapshot (R054 P1).

Provider start queue window: a PENDING reservation is created before queueing only when the host slot is free; if another attempt still holds the slot (its cleanup must run first) the worker reserves at run time as before, and a recreation inside that double race fails closed (adoption_failed error UI, no second start).
